failure.observation: Identical function classes were assumed to permit one final camera/light visibility result to be reused for every spatial instance.
mustNeverRepeat: shared shape function presented as proof of shared final visibility
shared unoccluded nDotL presented as proof of shared shadowed lighting
instance transforms or orientation omitted from the evaluation contract
one-percent compute claim without measured cost partition and correctness oracle
culling benefit attributed to function reuse

scope.includes: correctness boundary and performance-claim evidence for analytic/function instancing

gate.shared: Function code/data and canonical-space precompute may be shared only when class revision and shared parameters match.
gate.perInstance: Transforms, world bounds, orientation-dependent directions, camera visibility, occlusion and shadow visibility remain per spatial instance unless an explicit invariance proof covers the scene.
negativeControls: same function class at two depths with one occluded
same function class stacked along the light direction with different shadow visibility
same function class with different instance orientation
gate.performanceClaim: Reject an unconditional one-percent or 100x claim unless measured end-to-end remaining cost is <= 0.01 on the declared hardware and all correctness controls pass.
